eyeHeightFoot.note: Eye and target height of men on foot and gunners.

eyeHeightMounted.note: Eye and target height of mounted men.

sampleStep.note: Spacing of the points tested along a sight line. Numerical, not historical.

maxSight.note: Nothing is seen beyond this on a clear day.

recheckInterval.note: A sight line is re-tested this often. Numerical, not historical.

uphillSpeedLossPer10.note: Speed lost moving uphill, in proportion to the grade along the line of march, up to maxSlopeLoss. Replaces the baseline's flat 0.88 on any slope.

maxSlopeLoss.note: Cap on the uphill speed loss.
